body: Arrest: 1.5 s passive hold in Playing (cop in Arrest within 1.5 m) -> GameState::Busted with BustedPhase Arrest 2 s + Screen 3 s; break free = player gets beyond break_free_distance of the arresting cop while the attempt is active -> heat to next star. Rejected: a 2 s cuffing phase inside Playing with a break-free key (needs control locks in drive_characters, fire_weapons, swing_melee, tick_loadouts).

Corridor gap (TASK-010 QA Bug 1): in unblock's close-in fallback, try a queue slot beside the nearest non-yielding blocker (R + clearance = 0.8 m to its side) before seeking the target. Rejected: body avoidance in head_for's direct seek (changes every gang direct seek and leapfrogs two members toward the target). Geometry in scratch/corridor_geometry.txt.

Shared NPC gunfight layer: git mv gang/behavior/fire_line.rs -> tactics/fire_line.rs and move Ctx/Seek/Motion/head_for/walk/select + the hold-fire block into tactics/mod.rs, parameterised by a Discipline view built from GangCombatConfig or the police combat config. Rejected: police importing widened gang::behavior internals (police would depend on gang internals).

Wanted/crimes reset for Busted on OnExit(Busted), not OnEnter like Wasted: the arresting cop keeps its Arrest pose over the kneeling player during the 2 s arrest phase. Rejected: OnEnter reset (stars 0 -> every cop walks off mid-arrest).
Q2=B stretch (gang<->police hostility) stays off in T11: police targets stay player-only; enabling needs non-player targets in the cop FSM. Recommended default for the orchestrator.

Navmesh: keep sidewalk graph + A* + direct seek; decide by a seed-1 city chase gate (cops reach the player from ring spawns) and t11.py progress log; navmesh only after a reproduced stuck, as its own task.

Cop Leave state is terminal (dispatcher spawns fresh units) instead of Leave->Respond: re-engaging leaving units exceeds the escalation table after a wanted reset (12 SWAT at 1 star). Alternative rejected: dispatcher recalls Leave units up to the row cap (more machinery).

PoliceSystems ordered after WantedSystems as well as PopulationSystems; alternative (before WantedSystems) rejected because the dispatcher should see this tick stars/last_known and exact-tick gates need a fixed order.

Navmesh evidence gate N1 asserts liveness only and prints per-cop stuck data; alternative (hard RED per stuck cop) rejected: GDD 6.6 makes a stuck chase the trigger of a separate navmesh task, not a blocker of T11.

P9 death-vs-arrest: keep a single guard (player query Without<Dead>) and flip P9 by removing it; rejected V2's extra health.current<=0 check whose flip stays GREEN because bevy_ecs 0.19.1 auto_insert_apply_deferred (default true) applies detect_player_death's Dead insert before arrest_player (path HealthSystems::Death -> Perceive -> Decide -> arrest).

D6 re-specified: view toward edge A, assert no unit at the three clearly visible A points (30,-35),(30,-27),(30,-19) instead of 'every unit on B'; rejected V2's 'open floor, no occluder' fixture because the box/ramp/wall occlude A(-11),A(-3),A(13),A(21), which are legal spawns and nearer to last_known than any hidden B point.
P6 search graph moved to the square x in [-6,6], z in [-10,0]; rejected V2's square (+-12, z to -24) whose edges pass through the 4x5x4 box at (-10,-22.66) and the ramp.

Terminal Leave needs a fixture precondition: FSM tests raise heat and run one tick (stars recomputed in track_search) before spawn_unit; spawn_unit asserts stars>=1 when a SidewalkGraph exists. Rejected computing stars inside police_fsm (second source of stars).

D9 keeps the 12 old units in the camera view (Offscreen stays 0) so they are alive when heat returns to row 1; rejected V2's timing-based 'while still alive' which races despawn_police (units off-frame since spawn despawn as soon as they Leave).

Shared head_for (tactics/mod.rs): a route walked to its end is no longer re-planned by age; rejected leaving it (city probe: cops oscillated between the node nearest the player and the player every route_refresh_seconds, stuck 30-45 m away at hospital/plaza, N1 red) and rejected a navmesh (the stuck was a re-plan loop, not missing geometry).

PoliceUnit.dest and search_point are stored at chest height and dest_clear is sight_blocked(eyes, dest) directly; rejected plan's d + Y*float_height because last_known and the player are already chest points (would test a point 2*float_height up).
Cop BackOff in the keep band walks away with combat.reposition_gait (Walk); police config has no back_off_gait and adding one was not in the plan; alternative was chase_gait (Run).

N2 station_spawn_exists asserts equality with citygen::sidewalk_anchor of the first station (like the gang HQ gate) instead of 'within 30 m of the centre'; the 30 m rule was RED on correct code (31.7 m, large station footprint).

P9 flip 'remove Without<Dead> from arrest_player' stayed GREEN: police_fsm drops sees for a Dead player every tick, the cop leaves Arrest in Decide and the attempt cancels. Flip reworked: remove both guards (Without<Dead> and the FSM's dead-player filter) -> RED.

Police corridor gates use patrol pair and patrol-front/SWAT-rear as the starvation gates (flip RED 0 shots); the plan's SWAT-front/patrol-rear order fires 24 without the queue slot, kept only as a no-friendly-fire case.

P9: keep both death guards (arrest_player Without<Dead> and the FSM dead-player filter); rejected removing either: the FSM guard protects the arrest only via Decide-before-arrest order, the arrest filter is the local invariant.

Issue 4: queue_slot searched only on the AI slot (on_slot.then(..)); a found slot is kept as the plan off-slot like any spot, so off-slot no-plan ticks fall back to the pre-task close-in seek for <= 3 ticks. Alternative rejected: keep per-tick search and justify by the bench (costs rays every tick for a shooter with no usable slot).

Issue 3 ('bound the post-last-node straight segment'): the leg past the last route node now uses avoid_offset on the AI slot like a direct seek; alternative rejected: capping the leg length (would re-introduce a re-plan back to the goal node, the oscillation the head_for change fixed).

head_for gates use a Respond cop on the test floor (last known 45 m past goal node G, beyond direct_seek_distance) in a new tests/route_walk.rs; alternative rejected: a gang member (Idle home seek needs a GangTerritories fixture and a lost-target sequence).

Verdict NEEDS_FIXES on cop-to-cop friendly fire at the weapon-range edge (FireLine counts a body only while chest-to-centre along < range, the bullet reaches range from the muzzle to the capsule surface; 12-SWAT street probe: 4/5 layouts hit). Alternative rejected: SHIP-PENDING-RUNTIME with an owner note, because the defect is silent, headless-reproducible and the surround rows create its geometry by design.

Navmesh evidence taken from a distance-based BRP probe (flat distance <= 18 m, stall = no 1 m progress in 5 s) instead of t11.py's stuck list; alternative rejected: t11 Tracker, which marks a cop reached by Arrest/Attack state at any distance and ends the SWAT run after 2.6 s, so it cannot show a stuck cop.

Bug 1 range boundary: a body blocks while along < range + overreach, overreach = flat length of the muzzle offset (0.515 m) + the widest hittable horizontal radius max(capsule 0.3, head sphere 0.35). Sound bound by the triangle inequality (a bullet point is at most |muzzle_flat|+range from the chest, a touched body centre at most r further). Rejected: QA's `along - capsule_radius < range + 0.45` (misses the 0.35 m head sphere and the 0.25 m lateral muzzle offset) and measuring the line from the muzzle (moves spot/queue-slot geometry of every gate for a range-only defect).

t11 Tracker: arrival = flat distance <= keep_distance.1 of the unit kind (patrol 18, SWAT 12) parsed from escalation.ron, state ignored; Dead/Leave units not tracked; stuck keeps the latest pre-arrival stall with its state. The 4-star run keeps polling (bounds + arrivals) until 45 s after the heat write instead of ending at the first SWAT within 30 m. Alternative rejected: hard-failing on a non-arrived unit (Attack holds are the accepted Bug 3 risk, evidence only like N1).
